objects.description: One box-shaped DC battery at lower left, with two top terminals. A minus sign is on the left and a plus sign is on the right. Perspective side and top faces are mechanical structure, not additional cells or electrical junctions.

One tall upright cylindrical coil assembly at center, with oval top and lower rims and many unnumbered winding strokes. The smaller secondary winding shares the primary coil's cylindrical axis and frame; it is not a separate remote coil. The distinct wire endpoints and edition prose identify the two circuits. The pixels do not declare numerical turn counts.

A rectangular mechanical support beneath the cylinder, with perspective top and unlabelled horizontal texture/edges. These strokes and mounting details are not an instructional grid, scale, additional coil, resistor, or circuit nodes.
One knife switch below the coil, with two posts on a base, an inclined raised blade pivoting from the left and a visible open gap before the right post.

One upright framed galvanometer to the right, with an arched scale, a central vertical needle aimed at zero, a lower rectangular moving-mechanism housing, two external circuit terminals and a broad foot/base.

connections.description: The battery's negative terminal is wired around the left side to the upper-left primary-coil connection.
The battery's positive terminal is wired to the left switch post.
The right switch post is wired to the remaining primary-coil connection near the lower coil/support region. The switch gap interrupts this circuit.
A separate lead from the upper-right winding region curves to one galvanometer terminal.
The other secondary lead exits farther down the right winding region and curves to the other galvanometer terminal.

Primary and secondary are magnetically coupled/coaxial, not galvanically joined. The two secondary leads remain separate; support edges and overlapping perspective winding strokes are not permission to add electrical junctions.
